visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-down shirt, stands centrally in the frame. He gestures actively with his right hand while holding a small black clicker in his left. The background is a highly detailed 3D rendering of a microscopic honeycomb-like structure with translucent spheres within the cells, lit with a neutral, soft glow. (2) A large screenshot of a scientific article titled 'Age-related constraints on the spatial geometry of the brain' from Nature Communications appears as a partial overlay. The man continues to speak, his facial expressions animated with raised eyebrows and a wide mouth, indicating energetic delivery. (3) The man remains the focus, shifting his weight slightly as he points upward. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom. The background structure remains static, providing a scientific texture to the scene. (4) A scientific diagram showing a cross-section of a human brain with red arrow markers (labeled Global Distance) appears. The man's hands move into the lower portion of the frame, holding the clicker. (5) Transition back to the man's medium shot against the honeycomb background. He touches his temple with his index finger while explaining a point. (6) A sequence of brain morphing diagrams (represented by colored spheres) appears, illustrating 'compression' and 'expansion' across different ages. The man's silhouette is partially visible at the bottom. (7) The man returns to full view, now gesturing with both hands to emphasize the 'sagging' concept. (8) A second set of diagrams labeled 'Clinical Status' appears, showing a similar progression of brain shape changes. (9) The man concludes the video, smiling slightly and nodding, maintaining direct eye contact with the lens. The lighting is consistent, bright studio light throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 人老了 眼會垂臉會垂. [Logo]: 頻道會員限定 晶片崛起搶先看. (2) [Variety]: 大腦也會潰塌?. (3) [Subtitle]: 肚皮也會垂 但這些垂了都還有救. (4) [Subtitle]: 只有一個地方千萬不能垂 腦. (5) [Subtitle]: 這項由美國加州大學爾灣分校 與西班牙拉古納大學聯手. (6) [Subtitle]: 發表在《自然通訊》上的研究. (7) [Subtitle]: 首次證實了大腦整體的「三維形狀」. (8) [Subtitle]: 會隨著年齡系統性地「下垂」. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且垂的程度跟認知功能障礙有密切關聯. (10) [Subtitle]: 注意 過去幾十年說到腦的老化 都是說. (11) [Subtitle]: 「某某腦區萎縮了多少多少百分比」. (12) [Subtitle]: 但這次科學家說 只看體積損失是見樹不見林. (13) [Subtitle]: 大腦的老化更要看整個結構的「幾何形狀」垮不垮. (14) [Subtitle]: 蛤 打開腦核發現腦子上頭長了牙齒. (15) [Subtitle]: 那真是老不死. (16) [Subtitle]: 團隊分析了來自「OASIS-3」 與「Cam-CAN」兩個大型公開資料庫. (17) [Subtitle]: 共 2603 份從 30 歲到 97 歲的人腦 MRI 掃描. (18) [Subtitle]: 他們把整個大腦皮質當成一顆不規則的球. (19) [Subtitle]: 在上面標記數百個點 用電腦去量測左右半球. (20) [Subtitle]: 各個對應點之間的「歐幾里得距離」. (21) [Subtitle]: 也就是直線距離 繪製出大腦整體的「擴張」與「壓縮」地圖. (22) [Subtitle]: 而為了確保他們看到的 不是腦區「縮水」造成的假象. (23) [Subtitle]: 他們在統計模型中 刻意將每個腦區本身的「體積變化」. (24) [Subtitle]: 設定為不感興趣的共變量 把它的效應給排除掉. (25) [Subtitle]: 也就是說不管這個零件是胖是瘦 我只要知道結構有沒有跑掉. (26) [Subtitle]: 這樣一來抓到的就是最純粹的「腦下垂」. (27) [Subtitle]: 結果發現「大腦下垂模式」竟然是系統性的有跡可尋. (28) [Subtitle]: 首先是大腦的下前部區域 靠近額頭下方. (29) [Subtitle]: 像是地基鬆動一樣發生了擴張. (30) [Subtitle]: 再來是大腦的上後部區域 靠近頭頂後方. (31) [Subtitle]: 則像是屋頂被壓垮一樣發生了壓縮. (32) [Subtitle]: 重點來了 他們發現這種變形模式 與認知功能高度相關. (33) [Subtitle]: 例如後腦區域的壓縮程度 與參與者在推理能力測驗分數較低. (34) [Subtitle]: 有顯著關聯 而在臨床失智評分中顯示. (35) [Subtitle]: 有認知障礙的受試者身上 這種「下垂」模式. (36) [Subtitle]: 比正常老化的人更加嚴重. (37) [Subtitle]: 科學家 Michael Yassa 提出一個好犀利的推測. (38) [Subtitle]: 就是這個「下垂」很可能讓大腦裡一個超重要的記憶中樞. (39) [Subtitle]: 內嗅皮質 entorhinal cortex 壓力山大. (40) [Subtitle]: 好死不死 這裡剛好就是阿茲海默症的毒性蛋白. (41) [Subtitle]: 例如 Tau 蛋白 最早開始堆積的地方 是標準的雪上加霜. (42) [Subtitle]: 但這種「下垂」模式 也可能是一個全新的. (43) [Subtitle]: 可透過標準 MRI 掃描偵測的早期警報系統. (44) [Subtitle]: 讓醫療手段能及時干預. (45) [Subtitle]: 所以啊 知道自己「垂了」也不全是壞事.
